title: Why So Many Teens Already Trust An AI Friend
hook: Your kid might trust a chatbot more than you.
closing: Would you trust a chatbot with your secrets?
question: Ever talked to an AI like a friend?

segments.say: 72 percent of teens have now talked to an AI companion like it's a friend.
A third of teens have picked an AI over an actual person for a serious conversation.
34 percent of teens using an AI companion say it's done something that made them uncomfortable.
